name: blender2babylon-kit
description: Concept nodes for the Blender2BabylonKit (b2bkit) level pipeline: Blender add-on → level.glb + level.scene.json → Babylon.js runtime. Drop these instead of explaining the kit's tooling in node descriptions.

nodes.label: Export
nodes.desc: Validates the scene and writes level.glb + level.scene.json + sidecar media folders.

nodes.label: level.glb
nodes.desc: glTF artifact: meshes, hierarchy, standard materials, lights, cameras, animation clips, GUIDs in metadata.

nodes.label: level.scene.json
nodes.desc: Manifest artifact: ECS components, scene block, per-entity light/camera/animation, materials[], detailMaps[]. glTF can't express these.

nodes.label: Validator
nodes.desc: Pre-export warnings: missing scripts, bad refs, physics traps (mesh triggers, MESH collider + dynamic body, AREA lights).

nodes.label: Live Link
nodes.desc: Ctrl+S in Blender re-exports automatically; the dev server watches public/levels/ and reloads the browser.

nodes.label: Prefabs
nodes.desc: Linked library .blend files with per-instance library overrides; export from the level file.

nodes.label: GUID Matching
nodes.desc: Stable GUID stamped into each Blender object; the runtime matches manifest entities to glTF nodes by GUID, so renames don't break links. Needs ExtrasAsMetadata.

nodes.label: Project Control Panel
nodes.desc: Desktop hub for editors and docs: Start All / Vite, export a level from Blender.

nodes.label: bjs-mcp
nodes.desc: MCP server for LLM-assisted behavior authoring against the b2bkit runtime.

nodes.label: TAG
nodes.desc: Text label for queries and Event Message filters → entity.tag, attachment row.

nodes.label: SCRIPT
nodes.desc: Attaches a TypeScript behavior + tunable @exposed fields → Behavior instance on entity.behaviors.

nodes.label: ANIMATOR
nodes.desc: Action-clip state machine (node graph on the armature; clip names = Action names) → built-in AnimatorController.

nodes.label: COLLIDER
nodes.desc: Collision shape (box, sphere, convex, mesh); optional Event Messages. Part of one PhysicsBody per entity (compound if several). Use box/sphere/convex for triggers.

nodes.label: RIGIDBODY
nodes.desc: Mass, friction, dynamics (static / dynamic / animated). Same body as colliders on that object. MESH collider + DYNAMIC is not supported.

nodes.label: CONSTRAINT
nodes.desc: Physics joint to another body (hinge, slider, 6DoF) → Havok constraint on level.constraints.

nodes.label: CAMERA
nodes.desc: Replaces the exported camera with orbit / follow / geospatial controls → typed Babylon camera; may become level.activeCamera.

nodes.label: AUDIO
nodes.desc: Sound file, 2D or 3D spatial → StaticSound on entity.sounds.

nodes.label: GUI
nodes.desc: 2D HUD or mesh-projected UI from GUI Editor JSON → AdvancedDynamicTexture.

nodes.label: GUI3D
nodes.desc: 3D GUI controls (buttons, holo, mesh, stack/sphere/cylinder/plane/scatter panels) → Control3D; click fires OnMessage.

nodes.label: PARTICLE
nodes.desc: Particle or Node Particle system JSON → IParticleSystem on entity.

nodes.label: MSDF_TEXT
nodes.desc: Crisp 3D labels (bmfont JSON + atlas PNG) → TextRenderer; draws after the main pass.

nodes.label: RENDERING_GROUP
nodes.desc: Babylon draw-order group (0–3); optional propagation to owned meshes / child entities.

nodes.label: MESH_SHADOWS
nodes.desc: Cast/receive shadow modes; overrides ray visibility when enabled → mesh.receiveShadows + ShadowGenerator casters.

nodes.label: LAYER_MASK
nodes.desc: Babylon visibility bitmask for multi-camera / light filtering → mesh.layerMask on owned meshes.

nodes.label: COLLISION_LAYER
nodes.desc: Named Havok collision layer; optional propagation → PhysicsShape.filterMembershipMask / filterCollideMask.

nodes.label: REFLECTION_PROBE
nodes.desc: Local cubemap for nearby geometry inside an influence volume (not a sky replacement) → ReflectionProbe on entity.

nodes.label: Entity
nodes.desc: One exported object + its runtime attachments. For skinned meshes, put GUID, animation, and scripts on the armature.

nodes.label: Behavior
nodes.desc: Your TypeScript class from a SCRIPT component: subclass Behavior, @exposed fields, OnUpdate/OnStart hooks (PascalCase or they never run).

nodes.label: Attachment
nodes.desc: One applied component row (data + runtime object). Add/remove components at runtime via ComponentHost.

nodes.label: Level
nodes.desc: Container for all entities, scene subsystems, and the frame loop.

nodes.label: LevelLoader
nodes.desc: Loads the .glb, reads the manifest, matches entities by GUID, attaches components, runs FinalizeLevel subsystems (constraints, GUI3D, reflection probes).

nodes.label: GameClock
nodes.desc: Unified time authority: timeScale (slow-mo / pause), scaled + unscaled deltas.

nodes.label: OnMessage
nodes.desc: String messages from Event Messages, GUI, or SendMessage — the kit's event channel.

nodes.label: Environment / Skybox
nodes.desc: IBL from World texture or default studio HDR; clear/ambient color.

nodes.label: Fog
nodes.desc: Linear, exponential, or exponential² scene fog.

nodes.label: Atmosphere
nodes.desc: Physical sky; replaces the environment skybox when enabled.

nodes.label: Post-processing
nodes.desc: Bloom, DOF, SSAO, tone mapping, LUTs (cubeLutTexture), effects chain.

nodes.label: Input Actions
nodes.desc: Maps, actions, bindings + scene default map (Unity-style input).

nodes.label: Collision Layers
nodes.desc: Named layer list + N×N collision matrix (Unity-style) for Havok.

nodes.label: Light Budget / Clustering
nodes.desc: Forward vs clustered punctual lights; light budget per pixel.

nodes.label: Shadows
nodes.desc: Directional + mesh shadow generators; freeze shadows bakes maps once for static worlds.

nodes.label: Large World Rendering
nodes.desc: Floating-origin engine + Havok region radius for big maps.

nodes.label: NME Materials
nodes.desc: Node Material Encoding: link NME JSON per Blender material, scan/extract embedded textures, texture/input/gradient overrides. Matched by material name.

nodes.label: Detail Maps
nodes.desc: Packed or separate albedo/normal detail maps per material → DetailMapConfiguration on glTF.
